source_message.text:
After reviewing the complete landing-page example, Marissa, I no longer think my follow-on copy belongs there. Your designs have prompted some strong new ideas, though. Immediately after the initial hero section, I suggest adding How it Works, since that is the next information an interested prospect will want. The chevron-down icons are ideal for showing the sequence:

**How it Works**

* Begin by naming an account administrator and providing your company details
* Supply company background, for example by scanning your website
* Choose a business role for the agent, then give it a name and select a voice
* If desired, connect the agent to one of our collaborative applications
* Provide instructions for the agent, which can be revised at any time
* Set up a company email address for the agent and authorize access
* Invite staff to chat and message the agent through the dashboard
* Link an extension from your switchboard to the agent's phone
* Once setup is complete, introduce the agent and let it begin work

There will be more feedback, but I wanted to share this while the idea was still fresh.

Derek
